index.title: Automate Event Reminders for a Team
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Event Reminders. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Automate Event Reminders for a Team. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a diff
index.what_happened_excerpt: A calendar expert was hired to set up a system to send reminders to team members about upcoming events in a shared calendar. They connected the calendar to a web service and set up the reminders to be sent to the team members.
